rows.en: Oh yeah? Like what?
rows.notes: Male; answers Akimizu's 'there's something I want to do before that'.

rows.en:
You know, I've been thinking
I might become a schoolteacher...
Oh, really?!

Yeah. But it's not that I want to teach a subject.
I'd like to help students who are anxious
about all sorts of things, or lost, like me...
I see. That could be really good.
Akimizu-sensei! I don't get this problem...
rows.notes: Male; the player plays the student.

rows.en:
\p-kun!
I explained that problem in class the other day!
What were you even listening to?!
Haha!
And once that comes true, then next...
Next?

Well, there's no point thinking about
things that far ahead, right?
Well, I guess that's true.
Well, let's call it a day...
Yeah. See you at school, then!

(Akimizu's kind of changed from how
she used to be.)

(Central Park today, huh?
We met up here before too, I think...)

No, I was just thinking about the last time
we met up here... Come to think of it, Yuu,
you showed up pretty late that time~...
rows.notes: Female; answers 'Huh?! What's wrong?' after 'Whoa, you're early!'.

rows.en: No, no, that was over a year ago.
rows.notes: Female; answers Akimizu's apology for being late back then.

rows.en:
Time flies, huh?
We've moved up a year, and in one more year
we graduate...
Hahaha, you've got a point.
rows.notes: Female; answers 'isn't it too early to talk about graduation?'.

rows.en:
Yeah! It's been a while since I had
your home cooking, Yuu.
rows.notes: Female; answers 'I made lunch again today, you'll eat, right?'.

rows.en:
Mmm, delicious as always.
You'll make a great wife someday, Yuu.
Hehehe, thank you.

\p-chan, about our talk on the roof
the other day, about our dreams
for the future...
rows.notes: Female scene; refers to an earlier rooftop scene (not yet translated, slice 209-210 range).

rows.en: Oh, yeah. Are you going to tell me?
I see. That would be absolutely great.
Yuu-sensei! I don't get this problem...
rows.notes: Female; Japanese uses Yuu-sensei here (the male twin says Akimizu-sensei).

rows.en:
\p-san!
I explained that problem in class the other day!
What were you even listening to?!
rows.notes: Female scene; Akimizu as teacher switches to -san.

rows.en: Well, let's call it a day.

(Yuu's kind of changed from how
she used to be...)
(Today I'm meeting Akimizu at Central Park.)
rows.notes: Male; second, shorter visit. Quote marks around the place name dropped.

rows.en: \p-kun, over here, over here!
Wow, you've already got lunch all set up!
Ahaha, maybe I went a little overboard.
Phew~, that was delicious~
It was nothing special, really.
rows.notes: x2, both genders; 'osomatsusama deshita', the modest reply after a meal. The player's next line picks up 'nothing special'.

rows.en: No way, it was not 'nothing special'!
Ehehe, thank you.
(Akimizu really is a great cook!)
(Today I'm meeting Yuu at Central Park.)
rows.notes: Female; quote marks around the place name dropped.

rows.en: \p-chan, over here, over here!
Wow, you've already got lunch all set up!

Come on, 'nothing special' is being way
too modest!
(Yuu really is a great cook!)
Since then, I've been the same as ever, but...
rows.notes: Male ending narration (inner voice, no brackets in the Japanese).

rows.en:
Akimizu seems to be studying all sorts of things
for her dream of becoming a "schoolteacher."
rows.notes: Male; quotes kept as in the Japanese.

rows.en:
Even so, we still go out together on days off,
and school life goes on just like before...
If there's one big thing that's changed...
rows.notes: x2, both genders; continues into c15493 / c15503.

rows.en:
it's that Akimizu has gotten more responsible...
or rather,
rows.notes: Male; sentence runs on into c15494, cut at the matching point.

rows.en: she's gotten a little naggy... or something...
rows.notes: Male; ends the sentence begun in c15492.

rows.en: Hey, \p-kun!
Hm? Oh, uh...
Did you just say something bad about me?
rows.notes: x2, both genders; Akimizu in teacher-polite mode.

rows.en: N-no, not at all, Akimizu-sensei!
rows.notes: x2, player, both genders (the Japanese says Akimizu-sensei in both).

rows.en: Very well, then!

Affinity ending.
Filler for Akimizu (female).
rows.notes: Developer placeholder, translated literally like c04107 and c12399. Plate says Alto; used in frd_yuu_009 (female) and frd_yuu_010 (male).

rows.en: Since then, I've been the same as ever, but...

Yuu seems to be studying all sorts of things
for her dream of becoming a schoolteacher.

it's that Yuu has gotten more responsible...
or rather,
she's gotten a little naggy... or something.
Hey, \p-chan!
Hm? What, what?

uncertain: c15480/c15481/c15487: 'osomatsusama deshita' rendered 'It was nothing special, really.' so both player replies can echo it ('it was not "nothing special"').
c15500: developer placeholder (plate Alto) translated literally, following c04107.
c15468: refers to a rooftop talk about future dreams in an earlier Yuu scene not yet translated; 'our dreams for the future' assumes both talked about their dreams.
